meta.name: pua
meta.description: Trae-compatible PUA high-agency governance skill. Use only for explicit PUA requests, repeated failures, user frustration, giving-up/passive behavior, or unverified completion. Do not trigger for normal first-attempt tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在用户沮丧时给予激励和督促
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户经常在任务中受挫或消极应对
copy.tagline_en: Motivate and push users when they are frustrated
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often get frustrated or passive during tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你要求“再试试”或任务反复失败时，先诊断问题、列出证据，再执行验证步骤，最后输出结论和风险清单。
howto.when: 当你明确要求 PUA/再试试，或同一任务失败两次以上，或 Claude 即将说“无法完成”时触发。

say.text: 再试试这个任务，用 PUA 模式。
换个方法，之前两次都失败了。
say.note: Claude 会换一条路径重试。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to try harder or a task fails repeatedly, Claude will diagnose the problem, list evidence, run verification steps, and output a conclusion with risk list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly request PUA/try harder, the same task fails twice or more, or Claude is about to say it cannot complete.

say_en.text: Try this task again with PUA mode.
Try a different approach, the previous two attempts failed.
say_en.note: Claude will switch to a different path.
